dict.string: Speak to your assistant through your glasses during a listening session you start.
Turn spoken requests into text for your assistant.
Use your paired glasses for spoken requests and replies.
8Examples AI Assistant shares your location with your assigned assistant(s) so they can help with things near you — only if you say yes.
With “Always” access, 8Examples AI Assistant can send your location to your assigned assistant(s) every 5 minutes even while the app is closed. You can stop sharing any time from the Location tab.
